item.title: [LU-21265] kernel update [SLES15 SP7 6.4.0-150700.53.90.1]
item.description:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7 kernel was updated to fix various security
issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

  • CVE-2025-68219: cifs: fix memory leak in smb3_fs_context_parse_param error
    path (bsc#1255222).
  • CVE-2026-31708: smb: client: fix OOB read in smb2_ioctl_query_info
    QUERY_INFO path (bsc#1264022).
  • CVE-2026-31709: smb: client: validate the whole DACL before rewriting it in
    cifsacl (bsc#1264024).
  • CVE-2026-43350: smb: client: require a full NFS mode SID before reading mode
    bits (bsc#1264985).
  • CVE-2026-46155: smb/client: fix out-of-bounds read in smb2_compound_op()
    (bsc#1267720).
  • CVE-2026-64370: posix-cpu-timers: Fix pid refcount leak in
    do_cpu_nanosleep() error path (bsc#1273805).
  • CVE-2026-64380: smb: client: harden POSIX SID length parsing (bsc#1273557).
  • CVE-2026-64430: NTB: epf: Avoid calling pci_irq_vector() from hardirq
    context (bsc#1274257).
  • CVE-2026-64435: audit: Fix data races of skb_queue_len() readers on
    audit_queue (bsc#1274080).
  • CVE-2026-68186: binfmt_misc: set have_execfd only once the interpreter is
    opened (bsc#1274949).
  • CVE-2026-68436: drm/amd/display: use kvzalloc to allocate struct dc
    (bsc#1276275).
  • CVE-2026-68447: drm/amdkfd: clamp v9 CRIU control stack checkpoint copy to
    BO size (bsc#1276280).
  • CVE-2026-68460: f2fs: fix potential deadlock in f2fs_balance_fs()
    (bsc#1276774).
  • CVE-2026-72010: cgroup/cpuset: rebind mm mempolicy to effective_mems, not
    mems_allowed (bsc#1276776).
  • CVE-2026-72073: mmc: vub300: fix use-after-free on probe failure
    (bsc#1277157).
  • CVE-2026-72110: bpf,fork: wipe ->bpf_storage before bailouts that access it
    (bsc#1277357).
  • CVE-2026-72111: bpf: Reset register bounds before narrowing retval range in
    check_mem_access() (bsc#1277389).
  • CVE-2026-72250: netfilter: nf_conntrack_reasm: guard mac_header adjustment
    after IPv6 defrag (bsc#1277663).
  • CVE-2026-72253: netfilter: nf_conntrack_sip: validate skb_dst() before
    accessing it (bsc#1277665).
  • CVE-2026-72318: cifs: validate DFS referral string offsets (bsc#1275939).
  • CVE-2026-72405: net: udp_tunnel: prevent double queueing in
    udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync (bsc#1278033).
  • CVE-2026-72416: netfilter: nft_compat: ebtables emulation must reject non-
    bridge targets (bsc#1278041).
  • CVE-2026-72428: bpf: Fix stack slot index in nospec checks (bsc#1278050).
  • CVE-2026-74368: wifi: ath12k: fix memory leak in
    ath12k_wifi7_dp_rx_h_verify_tkip_mic() (bsc#1277103).
  • CVE-2026-74472: ublk: reset kernel-owned dev_info fields in
    ublk_ctrl_add_dev() (bsc#1277785).
  • CVE-2026-74613: vsock/virtio: avoid refilling the RX queue after teardown
    (bsc#1277903).
  • CVE-2026-74620: net/sched: act_gact, act_police: range check the fallback
    control action (bsc#1277044).
  • CVE-2026-74624: netfilter: nf_conntrack: defer invalid log until after
    unlock (bsc#1277599).
  • CVE-2026-74715: net: netfilter: Make ct zone opts configurable for bpf ct
    helpers (bsc#1277890).
  • CVE-2026-74746: netfilter: flowtable: publish GC-visible tuple last
    (bsc#1278101).
  • CVE-2026-74748: netfilter: ipset: fix refcount race between list:set GC and
    swap (bsc#1277578).
  • CVE-2026-80572: Input: byd - synchronize timer deletion before freeing
    private data (bsc#1277338).
  • CVE-2026-80602: perf/x86/amd/lbr: Fix kernel address leakage (bsc#1278123).
  • CVE-2026-80637: netfilter: synproxy: fix unaligned memory access in
    timestamp adjustment (bsc#1278343).
  • CVE-2026-80717: sctp: validate Adaptation Indication parameter length
    (bsc#1277836).
  • CVE-2026-80755: selinux: reject a permission value exceeding the class
    permission count (bsc#1278415).
  • CVE-2026-80757: selinux: reject a class permission count below its inherited
    common (bsc#1278711).
  • CVE-2026-80808: ext4: stop retrying saturated xattr cache entries
    (bsc#1279795).
  • CVE-2026-80809: ocfs2: fix missing metadata reservation for large xattrs
    (bsc#1279606).
  • CVE-2026-80855: fuse: fix invalidate lock leak on open O_TRUNC DAX failure
    (bsc#1279564).
  • CVE-2026-80879: ocfs2: fix circular locking dependency in
    ocfs2_dio_end_io_write (bsc#1279494).
  • CVE-2026-80881: ocfs2: fix buffer head management in ocfs2_read_blocks()
    (bsc#1279496).
  • CVE-2026-80978: ip6_gre: fix hardware header length for NBMA tunnels
    (bsc#1280253).
  • CVE-2026-89491: ocfs2: cluster: don't sleep while holding o2hb_live_lock in
    o2hb_region_pin() (bsc#1280472).
  • CVE-2026-89494: ocfs2: validate lengths in dlm_mig_lockres_handler
    (bsc#1280520).
  • CVE-2026-89495: ocfs2: bound namelen in dlm_migrate_request_handler
    (bsc#1280569).
  • CVE-2026-89537: SUNRPC: Reject short RFC 4121 MIC tokens in
    gss_krb5_verify_mic_v2 (bsc#1280713).
  • CVE-2026-89560: landlock: Require LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_REG for whiteout
    creation (bsc#1280806).
  • CVE-2026-89595: fsnotify: Fix stale object mask after concurrent mark
    updates (bsc#1280834).
  • CVE-2026-89608: ecryptfs: pass packet set buffer size to parser
    (bsc#1280826).
  • CVE-2026-89637: smb: client: fix UAF and buffer leak in cifs_check_trans2()
    for malformed secondary T2 (bsc#1280492).
  • CVE-2026-89649: ceph: bound xattr value length in __build_xattrs()
    (bsc#1280434).
  • CVE-2026-89654: ceph: fix UAF in check_new_map() on session freed during
    unlock (bsc#1280415).
  • CVE-2026-89655: ceph: fix UAF in __kick_flushing_caps() on cf entry freed
    during unlock (bsc#1280398).
  • CVE-2026-89656: libceph: reject buckets with mismatched CRUSH ids
    (bsc#1280563).
  • CVE-2026-89657: libceph: validate OSD extent maps before cursor advance
    (bsc#1280545).
  • CVE-2026-89751: x86/tdx: Fix off-by-one in port I/O handling (bsc#1280822).
  • CVE-2026-89761: apparmor: fix out-of-bounds write when null terminating a
    label vec (bsc#1280745).
  • CVE-2026-89786: ext4: fix out-of-bounds read in ext4_read_inline_dir()
    (bsc#1280976).
  • CVE-2026-89787: ext4: check dir entry fits before reading the hash trailer
    in ext4_search_dir() (bsc#1280977).
  • CVE-2026-90042: ceph: properly decrypt filenames in vmalloc() buffers
    (bsc#1280948).
  • CVE-2026-90092: Bluetooth: L2CAP: reject accept queue add unless BT_LISTEN
    (bsc#1281384).
  • CVE-2026-90128: vdpa/mlx5: fix wrong list iterated in add_direct_chain error
    path (bsc#1281577).
  • CVE-2026-90148: NFSv4: Fix incorrect argument passed to nfs4_delete_lease()
    in nfs4_add_lease() (bsc#1281551).
  • CVE-2026-90227: nvme/ioctl: check SUBMIT_IO with nvme_cmd_allowed()
    (bsc#1281705).
  • CVE-2026-90393: bpf: Fix potential UAF in bpf_netns_link_update_prog
    (bsc#1282289).
  • CVE-2026-93054: uio: Fix stale info pointer in failed registration path
    (bsc#1282276).
  • CVE-2026-93228: svcrdma: Reject Write/Reply chunks with segcount 0
    (bsc#1282697).
  • CVE-2026-93262: md/raid5-ppl: fix use-after-free in ppl_do_flush()
    (bsc#1283004).
  • CVE-2026-93795: blk-cgroup: fix leaks and online flag on radix_tree_insert
    failure (bsc#1283155).
  • CVE-2026-93798: btrfs: fix reloc root cleanup in merge_reloc_roots()
    (bsc#1282769).
  • CVE-2026-93817: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime (bsc#1283017).
  • CVE-2026-97575: media: v4l2-ctrls: validate AV1 tile counts (bsc#1283337).
  • CVE-2026-97605: erofs: preserve LZMA decoders on resize failure
    (bsc#1283173).
  • CVE-2026-97926: ufs: validate cylinder group metadata before caching it
    (bsc#1283887).
  • CVE-2026-98041: bpf: Don't predict JMP32 pointer vs zero comparisons
    (bsc#1284064).
  • CVE-2026-98086: ALSA: ump: do not touch legacy_rmidi before it exists
    (bsc#1283785).
  • CVE-2026-98264: ALSA: virtio: reset device before deleting virtqueues
    (bsc#1284363).
  • CVE-2026-98306: seg6: set IPSKB_L3SLAVE from IP6SKB_L3SLAVE on IPIP
    decapsulation (bsc#1284505).
  • CVE-2026-98368: esp: downgrade zerocopy managed frags before mutating skb
    frags (bsc#1284498).
  • CVE-2026-98374: tcp: fix use-after-free of retransmit_skb_hint in
    tcp_send_synack() (bsc#1284740).
  • CVE-2026-98432: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period
    (bsc#1285685).
  • CVE-2026-98471: KVM: SEV: Do cache maintenance on the source VM during
    intra-host migration (bsc#1286240).

The following non security issues were fixed:
https://lists.suse.com/pipermail/sle-security-updates/2026-November/030394.html

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.
